annotations.title: Ask a person to find this bus

description: Send a buyer's bus requirements to a CommercialBuses person, who searches participating dealer inventory and replies by email. Use only when the buyer has asked you to, with their real name and email: they will be contacted. Free for the buyer. Mention a specific listing in notes if they want that unit.

bus_types.description: One or more category slugs from list_bus_categories.

buyer_consented.description: Must be true: the buyer asked for this request to be sent.

city.description: Where the buyer needs the bus.

notes.description: Anything else, including a listing URL they liked.

organization.description: Church, school, company or agency, if any.

timeline.description: When they need it, in their words.

name: request_bus
